messages:
Allison (CEO): Thanks for the all-hands — opening this thread for fast Qs on partner GTM, pipeline signals, and next steps. Keep replies short.

Maya (Product): Quick product ask: can we propagate partner_tag into telemetry so we can attribute latency/cost to partner-led traffic? This is needed to set SLA-based routing.

Ravi (Sales): Also need a clear definition for pipeline conversion stages for partner-sourced opps vs direct. Sales ops keeps seeing mis-tagged opps causing forecast drift.

Elena (Partnerships): Enablement note: onboarding kit will include an opp-tagging cheat sheet. We'll ask partners to copy a short referral code into initial intro emails. That should help attribution.

Priya (Rev Ops): On crediting: deciding between flat referral % vs tiered. Proposal on table: flat 30% Y1 for small partners, tiered (20-40%) for strategic depending on ARR contribution. Circulating draft Monday.

Ben (GTM): Leadership asks: a saved dashboard that shows partner-influenced ARR velocity, average time-in-stage, and win-rate by partner type. I'll build it once partner_tag lands in telemetry/CRM. ETA: 2 weeks after fields land.

Maya (Product): Feasible: we can add partner_tag to request headers and telemetry payloads. Estimate 1 sprint to land server-side + 2 days for schema + docs. Need prioritization.

Ravi (Sales): Compensation question: will partner-influenced deals count fully for rep quota? Need clarity for Q4 planning.

Allison (CEO): Short decision: partner-influenced deals count toward rep quota at full credit. Partner payout and rep crediting handled separately via the influence/referral policy. Priya to finalize mapping.

Elena (Partnerships): Pilot plan: run 3 partners next month (one ISV, one SI, one reseller). Objective: test onboarding compress to 4w and validate attribution accuracy.

Priya (Rev Ops): I'll publish the influence/referral policy draft and quota mapping doc by Monday EOD with examples (email + CRM screenshots).

ops-bot: File uploaded: https://redwood.app/files/partner-attribution-cheatsheet.pdf

Maya (Product): Action items recap: Product to add partner_tag to telemetry (1 sprint), Ben to queue dashboard (2w after fields), Partnerships to run 3-partner pilot, Priya to finalize crediting docs. Leaving thread open for quick clarifications. :sparkles:
